name: cable side lying lateral raise
description: A lateral raise performed while lying on your side with a cable. Lying down keeps constant tension on the side delt.
instructions: Lie on your side next to a low cable pulley and grab the handle with your top hand.
Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is near shoulder height.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.
